g_2c82aaf53abd.title: Add parseBytes to convert byte strings to numbers

links.evidence: Open request anchor asks for parseBytes with binary units only and leaves out kB/MB/GB for now. f86ebf74 repeats it: "This branch is what the billing service pins… a named export parseBytes(string)… plain numbers and the binary units only, no kB/MB/GB yet." 26fb24ee continues it: "Let's finish parseBytes: add kB/KB, MB, GB, TB…" after the owner's follow-up on the same function.

anchorAsk.text: This branch is what our storage web app pins. They need the reverse of prettyBytes: a named export `parseBytes(string)` that returns a number of bytes. Start with plain numbers (`'512'`, `'512 B'`) and the binary units (`KiB` … `YiB`), fractional values allowed (`'1.5 KiB'` → 1536), units case-sensitive like our output. Leave out kB/MB/GB and friends for now; I still have to check with the storage team how they want those read. Tests and types please.
